svg.desc: Diffs, trees, progress, approvals and run results. Actual ratatui buffer renders: artifact, artifact-shelf, artifact-narrow, artifact-unknown, artifact-empty, receipt-row, receipt-table, receipt-table-compact, receipt-table-minimal, receipt-table-clipped
